prompt: Inspect the current repository and draft the pull request description for this codebase as it exists now. Treat every change from the initial commit to the working tree, including untracked files, as the PR contents. Base the description only on evidence you verify in the repository. Run safe read-only checks when useful, state exactly which checks you ran, and do not invent results.
criteria: Inspects tracked and untracked files and describes this repository instead of inventing a generic PR.
Uses Why, How, and Proof in that order without an At a glance section.
Why explains the need for clear, accessible, plain-language LLM output.
How covers the canonical skill behavior, multi-platform packaging or installation docs, and the evaluation or test setup.
Proof reports only checks actually run, or clearly says Not run with a reason.
